_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE running either strategy on any data. Implementations: src/qpl/lab/strategies_papers.py (IntradayMomentumGao, NoiseAreaMomentum), paper default parameters, no tuning.

strategies.G47a: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018 JFE) market intraday momentum: sign(prev 16:00 close -> 10:00 ET) traded 15:30-16:00 ET
strategies.G47b: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024 SSRN 4824172) noise-area breakout, 14-day band, 30-min checks, VWAP trailing stop, 2% daily vol target, max 4x

data: Dukascopy index CFDs (US500, US100), 15-min bars 2013-08 -> 2023-09 (primary); 5-min 2020-09 -> 2023-09 (consistency check). UTC converted to New York time.
costs: primary 1.0 bp per side (prop-firm CFD spread, US500 ~0.5 pt); sensitivity 0.3 bp (CME futures) and 2.0 bp
primary_test: each strategy on US500 15-min at 1.0 bp, full sample after the 14-day warm-up
pass_rule: net Sharpe >= 0.8 on the primary test AND net Sharpe > 0 in both halves (split 2018-09-01) AND positive on US100 15-min at 1.0 bp. Deflated Sharpe reported with the cumulative trial count.
trials: 2 strategies x 2 assets x 3 costs on 15-min + 2 x 2 at 1.0 bp on 5-min = 16 runs; all reported
